summary: Added sdk/fleet with AccountProfile (alias rule, registered policy, strategy key format, budgets for minerals/gas/starbux with starbux 0 by default, positive max_actions, boolean enabled, upper-snake secret name), AccountRegistry (unique aliases, enabled() in alias order) and load_registry/registry_from_dict (version 1, unknown fields refused, secret-named keys and secret-shaped values refused anywhere, errors never echo values). 8 tests in tests/test_fleet_accounts.py. Documented in docs/baseline/fleet-accounts.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Every run handled one account with no account-level objectives or budgets
contract_status_changes.after: A validated registry describes each account's objective, policy, strategy, budgets and credential secret name

residual_risks: Budgets are declared here but enforced only once the orchestrator slice lands.
